title: Senior Graphic Designer
description: Design campaign visuals, social media creatives, and brand assets for a fast-growing agency. You will own the design process from brief to final export and collaborate with copywriters and account managers.

title: Full-Stack Web Developer
description: Build and maintain client websites and internal tools end to end. Comfort with Laravel or Django on the back end and modern JavaScript on the front end is required, plus solid database fundamentals.

title: Banking Operations Officer
description: Handle daily branch operations, account maintenance, and customer transactions with accuracy and care. A degree in accounting, finance, or management plus 1+ year in banking operations is preferred.

title: Registered Nurse
description: Provide patient care in a busy private hospital, including medication administration, patient assessment, and family education. BSc in Nursing and a valid license to practice in Ethiopia are required.

title: Civil Engineer
description: Supervise construction works, review structural drawings, and ensure quality and safety on site. BSc in Civil Engineering with 5+ years of experience in building projects is required.

title: Sales Manager
description: Lead a sales team, set targets, and grow the company's B2B accounts across the region. Proven track record in sales leadership and strong relationship-building skills are essential.

title: Journalist / Reporter
description: Research, write, and file news stories on deadline for a national weekly. Strong Amharic and English writing, sharp news judgement, and willingness to travel within Ethiopia are required.

title: HR Officer
description: Support recruitment, onboarding, payroll liaison, and employee relations at a mid-size firm. BA in management or HR with 2+ years of HR experience and familiarity with Ethiopian labour law is preferred.

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
description: Write and execute test plans, automate regression suites, and report defects clearly. Experience with manual and automated testing of web applications and strong attention to detail are required.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description: Run paid and organic campaigns across social media and search, analyse performance, and report on ROI. Hands-on experience with Meta and Google Ads plus strong copywriting skills are preferred.

title: Senior Flutter Developer
description: We are looking for a senior Flutter developer to own our flagship mobile app. You will build cross-platform features end to end, mentor two mid-level engineers, and work closely with design on a polished, high-performance experience. 5+ years of mobile experience with a strong Dart/Flutter portfolio is required.

title: Frontend Engineer (React)
description: Join our product team building a modern web platform used by thousands of daily users. You will work with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind to ship clean, accessible UI. We value ownership, clear communication, and attention to detail.
